name: 自定义制作

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: 用户描述目标；素材可由用户提供或由方案安排获取。

steps.action: 先确定自建ComfyUI或RH及具名配置；已有本次明确选择直接沿用
初始只读核对连通、库存、收费与宿主工具，作为介绍选项依据；不声称最终需求可执行
至多一张概览介绍默认起点和可讨论方向；声明非制作清单、不保证全部采用，围绕内容持续沟通，由Agent据需求安排
结合上下文持续理解用户想表达的内容和效果；不要求先选完技术菜单，已有明确要求不重复问
读取适用技巧，按本次选择设计文字分镜、节点和提示词；storyboard_images=false时不调用生图或插入图片审定
仅storyboard_images=true时提前生成并查看图片分镜；关闭则沿用真实参考图与文字方案
最终需求确定后、提交前，按实际图和输入复核所选平台模型/节点/规格/资源/费用；与初始库存检查分开
按授权数量和费用执行；只恢复原任务
仅有效配置review=true或用户单独要求审查时执行内容审查与图文报告；关闭时不抽帧、不生成审查报告
默认只交视频与实际请求参数；review=true才附HTML审查报告；超分成功附原片

execution: Agent plans then compiles a task-specific execution manifest; this entry itself must never be treated as a ready generation graph
delivery: 自定义制作默认交付成片MP4和实际请求参数JSON；review=true才生成并交付HTML审查报告；超分成功另附原片。下载、文件完整性和可播放性等基本交付检查仍执行，不以此声称内容合格。

default_production.mode: REF when suitable references exist; otherwise choose supported mode for the brief
default_production.dimension_policy: Resolve exact width and height from live model/node alignment constraints; do not silently lower resolution or change orientation

intake_policy.scope: custom-production only; product-showcase remains a fixed recipe

default_configuration_notice.text: 默认配置可以修改：只改本次直接说；想以后都沿用，请说“以后默认……”。
default_configuration_notice.tracking: use current conversation history or host session state; do not persist a global already-shown flag

entry_selection.when_ambiguous: ask existing template or custom before entering this workflow
example_ambiguous: 我们来创作一个新的视频
entry_selection.question: 你想使用现成模板，还是按你的想法自定义制作？目前模板有商品宣传。
entry_selection.context_explicit_choice: reuse current context without asking again

presentation.opening_notice: 你只管描述想拍什么，我们边聊边确定，我会按实际需求安排。下面是默认起点与可讨论方向，不是本次制作清单，表中内容不一定会采用，也可提出表外需求。

readiness_checks.initial: read-only connectivity, inventory, billing route and host tools for option presentation
readiness_checks.final: after final requirements, before submission; validate actual graph/model/input/specification/resources/authorized-cost

open_ended_requests.implementation: reuse applicable guides; otherwise inspect actual nodes/docs/tools and research a task-local implementation

long_video_options.default_selection: recommend from content unless user specifies

review_policy.when_disabled: skip content review, frame evidence extraction and HTML report; retain basic download/file/playability verification
review_policy.when_enabled: follow quality-review guide and comparison report format

technique_options.name: 提前生成图片分镜
technique_options.purpose: 先设计人物、场景和构图，再作为视频参考；多一步生图和查看设计图

technique_options.name: 视频动作/运镜参考
technique_options.default: only if requested or chosen for relevant brief
technique_options.purpose: 用已有视频示意动作与镜头，需实际视频参考能力；不自动生成白模

technique_options.name: 运镜与背景效果
technique_options.purpose: 可选镜头风格、环境和背景特效，由用户内容决定，不额外强加制作步骤

technique_options.name: 长视频拼接或H3参考续接
technique_options.default: only when requested duration needs it

storyboard_policy.when_disabled: Use supplied references and text shot planning; no new storyboard image generation, image approval stage or associated mandatory capability
storyboard_policy.when_enabled: Read storyboarding guide, check actual image tool, design and inspect images before video generation
